grammar.summary: 本课学习 be accustomed to doing 与 early training 语义。

points.title: be accustomed to doing
points.explanation: = 习惯于（正式版 be used to doing）：children become accustomed to swimming。to 是介词。

examples.en: They are accustomed to swimming in winter.

points.title: 表"专家级"的 expert at
points.explanation: expert at/in doing = 擅长某活动，形容词 + 介词 + 动名词。

examples.en: Some of them are expert at swimming.
examples.cn: 他们中有些人游泳很在行。
